from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsPayableLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A single accounts payable line item from one company's balance sheet."""
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label as written in the balance sheet (e.g., 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable - related party')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount for this line item")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document containing this line item")

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial information from one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The registrant/company name as named in the document")
    filing_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of SEC filing, e.g., '10-Q'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date for the financials")
    accounts_payable_items: list[AccountsPayableLineItem] = Field(description="All accounts payable related line items found in this filing")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
